near.text: Frisco: State Farm has the cheapest average minimum-coverage rate, $48 a month.
Dallas: Auto Club (AAA) has the cheapest median full-coverage rate for a clean record, $1,764 a year; minimum coverage $637 a year.
Frisco-specific full-coverage averages by company were not published by these sources. Use HelpInsure.com (Texas Department of Insurance) with ZIP 75034 for local sample rates.

delivery.text: DoorDash's own insurance page names "State Farm's delivery-friendly policy" as an option. State Farm says a standard State Farm policy may cover deliveries in some situations, and tells drivers to disclose delivery work to an agent.
2026 reviews from MoneyGeek and InsureMojo both say GEICO's rideshare/delivery policy is NOT sold in Texas. Call GEICO to confirm before relying on it for delivery work.
Progressive says its rideshare add-on covers drivers on delivery apps like DoorDash and Uber Eats "in most states." It doesn't name Texas on that page, so call 1-855-347-3939 to confirm for Texas.

Allstate sells a "Ride for Hire" add-on and says it's not available in every state. 2026 reviews (MoneyGeek, InsureMojo) list Texas as one of the states that have it. Confirm that it covers food delivery.

insurers.name: Farmers

delivery.text: Farmers sells a Farmers Flex Personal Auto policy in Texas. Farmers' Flex coverage page lists optional Ride Share and Food Delivery coverage for driving with an app-based company, whether carrying passengers or delivering food. That same page says not all coverages are available in every state, so ask a Farmers agent to confirm it is sold in Texas and that it covers DoorDash or courier work. Farmers also describes a separate Rideshare add-on for ride-hailing companies like Uber, to fill the gap when you are logged into the app but have not accepted a ride.

claims.hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

insurers.texasNote: Farmers sells auto insurance in Texas, including the Farmers Flex Personal Auto policy. Texas minimum liability is 30/60/25 as of November 2022.

insurers.affiliatesNote: Bristol West and Foremost are part of the Farmers Insurance Group of Companies, according to Farmers' own companies page. Foremost became a member in 2000 and Bristol West in 2007. Bristol West sells non-standard private-passenger auto insurance. Foremost sells auto, home and specialty policies such as mobile homes, motorcycles and boats.
insurers.telematicsNote: Farmers' Texas page lists the Signal app. Farmers says Signal and the Signal discount are not available in Florida, Hawaii and New York, and the Signal discount is not available in California. Texas is not on that exclusion list. You can get an initial discount for enrolling; safer driving may lower the renewal price, and riskier driving can raise it. Optional CrashAssist can try to detect a crash and send help. To enroll, Farmers says to talk to an agent or call 800-709-7821.
